title: Restore Canonical Record Run ID Checks Without Recursion

context.current_bad_state: The latest PR removed recursive run_id scanning but over-corrected by checking only manifest.json and run.json. It now misses canonical direct run_id mismatches in timeline.jsonl, decisions.json, evaluations.json, and regressions.json records.
context.required_balance: Do not recursively scan nested values. Do check direct run_id on canonical package records.

task.summary: Fix run_id consistency so it checks all canonical direct record locations without recursive nested scanning.
task.user_story: As an Ailuros maintainer, I want package run_id validation to detect direct canonical record mismatches while ignoring nested non-canonical metadata/reference run IDs.
non_goals: Do not touch summary.md read handling.
Do not touch JSON/JSONL parse aggregation.
Do not touch audit package export formatting.
Do not add new architecture, docs, API, dashboard, auth, runtime blocking, or policy DSL work.

exact_required_behavior: Add _record_list_run_ids(value: Any) -> list[str] that returns direct top-level run_id values from list items only when the item is a dict.
Update _run_id_reasons or its helper so present_run_ids includes manifest.run_id, run.run_id, timeline[*].run_id, decisions[*].run_id, evaluations[*].run_id, and regressions[*].run_id.
Do not inspect nested dictionaries inside those records.
Do not restore recursive _find_run_ids or equivalent recursive scanning.
Do not reduce validation to only manifest.json and run.json.
Keep missing run_id errors for manifest.json and run.json only. Timeline/decision/evaluation/regression run_id fields are optional, but if present they are canonical and must match.
reference_implementation: present_run_ids = {run_id for run_id in canonical_run_ids.values() if run_id is not None}
for records in (package.timeline, package.decisions, package.evaluations, package.regressions):
canonical_locations: timeline[*].run_id optional but canonical if present
decisions[*].run_id optional but canonical if present
evaluations[*].run_id optional but canonical if present
regressions[*].run_id optional but canonical if present

required_tests.name: test_direct_timeline_run_id_mismatch_fails
required_tests.expected: valid=false, decision=FAIL, reasons include mismatched run_id values: other-run, run-001

required_tests.name: test_nested_noncanonical_run_ids_are_ignored
required_tests.setup: decisions/evaluations/regressions records contain nested metadata.run_id, baseline.run_id, reference.run_id values different from run-001 but no direct mismatching run_id

acceptance_criteria: Direct canonical record-level run_id mismatches fail for timeline, decisions, evaluations, and regressions.
Nested non-canonical run_id-like values do not fail validation.
No recursive run_id scan function is used.
Validation is not limited to only manifest.json and run.json.
Existing summary.md and UTF-8 error tests continue to pass.

notes: If full pytest fails due to known unrelated Clarify/release smoke baseline failures, report exact failing tests. Do not call it green.

must_check: present_run_ids includes manifest/run plus direct run_id from timeline, decisions, evaluations, and regressions records.
No recursive arbitrary nested run_id scanning remains in validation behavior.
Tests prove direct timeline/decision/evaluation/regression run_id mismatch fails.
Tests prove nested metadata/reference/baseline run_id values are ignored.
No unrelated file churn is introduced.
All validation commands are run and reported honestly.
reject_if: Only manifest.json and run.json are checked for run_id consistency.
Any recursive nested run_id scanner is used for consistency validation.
Direct canonical record-level run_id mismatch is ignored.
Nested non-canonical run_id mismatch causes FAIL.
The patch touches forbidden paths or unrelated behavior.
Tests are loosened or deleted instead of adding focused coverage.
